description: Which sources the filters let through and the order they are shown in (FlowKit SourceRanker.passes and rank, web/src/lib/sources/order.ts passes and arrangeSources). The website scores sources for the browser before this step; here that score is the order given. Providers are all named in the provider order or listed alphabetically: the apps order unnamed providers by name and the website by Settings order (see the report).
